# Kinetic

> 316 motion components for React. Every component ships its full source, a
> shadcn registry item, and a prompt written for coding agents.

Each component has a prompt at https://kinetic.example.com/prompts/<slug>.md

## Scroll

- [Banded Scrollspy Rail](https://kinetic.example.com/c/banded-scrollspy-rail): A tick rail whose active mark widens as a section crosses a 7% band through the middle of the screen.
- [Batched Blur Reveal](https://kinetic.example.com/c/batched-blur-reveal): Cards that enter together focus in as one staggered group instead of arriving as a slab.
- [One Reveal Engine, Two Axes](https://kinetic.example.com/c/container-animation-reveals): The same staggered line reveal fires for vertical sections and for panels on a horizontal track.
- [Converging Flow Steps](https://kinetic.example.com/c/converging-flow-steps): A process diagram that closes from both ends while the connectors pop in a third of the way through.
- [CSS Variable Stagger Reveal](https://kinetic.example.com/c/css-var-stagger-reveal): Groups reveal as they enter their scroll container; the stagger delay is a CSS calc over an index the JS writes once.
- [Dataset-Driven Parallax](https://kinetic.example.com/c/dataset-parallax): Layers drift at a rate written on the element itself, over the widest possible scroll window.
- [Drag-Throw Scroll](https://kinetic.example.com/c/drag-throw-scroll): Grab the page and pull it; let go mid-move and it coasts on, decaying, as far as the flick earned.
- [Drag Mapped To Pin Progress](https://kinetic.example.com/c/drag-to-pin-progress): Drag a pinned horizontal strip and it moves exactly one pixel per pixel, then throws and settles.
- [Dual-Direction Scrub Entrance](https://kinetic.example.com/c/dual-direction-scrub-entrance): Copy rises while a panel slides in from the side, both on one scrub with 600ms of lag.
- [Inverse Scroll Scale](https://kinetic.example.com/c/inverse-scroll-scale): Media enters oversized at 1.25x and settles to exactly 1.0 as it rises through the first 60% of the scroller.
- [IntersectionObserver Reveal](https://kinetic.example.com/c/io-reveal-lite): One element, one fade-and-rise on entry, no stylesheet and no library — with a single observer shared across every instance.
- [Single Param Object Timeline](https://kinetic.example.com/c/keyframe-param-object): One plain object holds every animated value; the scroll story is a table of keyframes anchored to real sections.
- [Knockout Zoom Pin](https://kinetic.example.com/c/knockout-zoom-pin): A word the size of the screen shrinks into a headline as you scroll, with the scene showing through its letters.
- [Lenis On The GSAP Ticker](https://kinetic.example.com/c/lenis-gsap-ticker): Smooth scroll and ScrollTrigger on one clock, with the lag-smoothing line everyone omits.
- [Manufactured Scroll Range](https://kinetic.example.com/c/manufactured-scroll-range): An empty box N screens tall turns a one-screen scene into a scrollable sequence, with progress as a CSS variable and the index as state.
- [Mixed Scrub Depth Layers](https://kinetic.example.com/c/mixed-scrub-depth-layers): Layers separate while you scroll and converge when you stop, because each depth has its own scrub.
- [Pinned Horizontal Track](https://kinetic.example.com/c/pinned-horizontal-track): A section pins while a strip of panels slides sideways, one scroll pixel per track pixel.
- [Pre-Scatter Horizontal Gallery](https://kinetic.example.com/c/prescatter-horizontal-gallery): A pinned strip where each item rests slightly off its slot, flies in from ahead and peels away behind.
- [Scroll-Scrubbed Video](https://kinetic.example.com/c/scroll-scrubbed-video): The scroll-to-frame mapping a scrubbed hero actually needs: smoothing, a snap, a frame quantiser and a loop that parks itself.
- [Scrub Timeline Spine](https://kinetic.example.com/c/scrub-timeline-spine): A rule that fills as you scroll, with entries alternating either side and reversing on the way back.
- [Throttled Scrub To State](https://kinetic.example.com/c/throttled-scrub-state): A scrubbed trigger fires 120x a second; a time, distance and frame gate turns that into a handful of React renders.
- [Velocity-Deformed Cards](https://kinetic.example.com/c/velocity-deform-cards): Cards skew, stretch and trail in proportion to scroll speed, then settle on their own with no easing curve anywhere.

## WebGL

- [Anti-Aliased Point Discs](https://kinetic.example.com/c/antialiased-disc-fragment): A phyllotaxis field of dots that stay the same weight at every pixel ratio, with no MSAA and no texture.
- [Bayer-Quantised Plasma](https://kinetic.example.com/c/bayer-plasma-hero): An iterated domain-warped plasma crushed to eleven grey levels, so the hero reads as a dot-matrix proof.
- [Bit-Math Bayer8 Dither](https://kinetic.example.com/c/bayer8-ordered-dither): A smooth gradient crushed to five levels through an 8x8 ordered matrix derived from six integer ops.
- [Cursor-Reactive Shader Glow](https://kinetic.example.com/c/cursor-reactive-shader-glow): A warped-noise atmosphere with a light that trails the cursor, held under a hard luminance ceiling so copy stays readable.
- [Dot-Cloud Score Cylinder](https://kinetic.example.com/c/cylinder-dot-score): Two counter-rotating cylinders of dots — rings, bar lines, notes — drawn from one buffer with no depth buffer.
- [Cylinder Gallery Drum](https://kinetic.example.com/c/cylinder-gallery): Nineteen planes wrapped around a drum in the vertex shader, spun by wheel or scroll, focus falling off from centre.
- [Depth Fade And Travelling Pulse](https://kinetic.example.com/c/depth-pulse-travelling-wave): A dot lattice on an arc: z drives alpha and point size together, and a per-column phase sweeps the pulse across the field.
- [Domain-Warped FBM Fog](https://kinetic.example.com/c/domain-warped-fbm): Slow, low-contrast fog that flows rather than fades, with a faint light that trails the cursor.
- [Dual-Canvas Depth Split](https://kinetic.example.com/c/dual-canvas-z-split): One particle field rendered twice with the depth sign flipped, so the text sits inside the field rather than on top of it.
- [Fractional Render Scale](https://kinetic.example.com/c/fractional-render-scale): A field rendered into a backing store 0.6x its box — 36% of the fragments — with a grid measured in texels so the upscale never shows.
- [Fullscreen Triangle Pass](https://kinetic.example.com/c/fullscreen-triangle-pass): One 3-vertex triangle covers the viewport and runs your fragment shader. No three, no ogl, no seam.
- [GPU Cubic-Bezier Burst](https://kinetic.example.com/c/gpu-bezier-burst): Rings of dots that burst on click, every particle solving its own cubic-bezier easing in the vertex shader.
- [Instanced Quad Particles](https://kinetic.example.com/c/instanced-quad-particles): Up to 1800 drifting particles in one draw call — quads rather than point sprites, so each one has its own size, spin and shape.
- [Multipass Offscreen Composite](https://kinetic.example.com/c/multipass-offscreen-composite): Four passes into two render targets — ramp, additive fills, half-size bloom — and one composite that writes the canvas once.
- [In-Shader Mouse Bulge](https://kinetic.example.com/c/ndc-mouse-bulge): A soft lens that follows the cursor, measured by projecting every vertex to screen space instead of raycasting.
- [Single-Draw Orbit Rings](https://kinetic.example.com/c/orbit-ring-points): Concentric rings of dots, one bright marker travelling each ring, all of it in a single draw call.
- [Radial Ripple Dot Cloud](https://kinetic.example.com/c/radial-ripple-dot-cloud): A dot field with a travelling wave running out of one off-centre point, its density drawn by hand as a B-spline.
- [Realtime Cube EnvMap](https://kinetic.example.com/c/realtime-cube-envmap): A metal knot reflecting panels that are actually orbiting it, captured six faces at a time every other frame.
- [Scroll Deformation Wave](https://kinetic.example.com/c/scroll-deform-wave): An image that ripples with scroll speed and bends the other way on the way back, from two sine terms.
- [Spring Lattice Field](https://kinetic.example.com/c/spring-lattice-field): A CPU damped-spring lattice uploaded as a texture each frame, displacing a procedural grid the cursor can push around.
- [Stepped Film Grain](https://kinetic.example.com/c/stepped-film-grain): A transparent grain overlay whose pattern jumps twelve times a second instead of every frame, so it reads as film.
- [Superellipse Text Avoidance](https://kinetic.example.com/c/superellipse-text-avoidance): A particle field that flows around the headline, held off by a 6-norm superellipse fitted to the measured text box.
- [Area-Weighted Surface Particles](https://kinetic.example.com/c/surface-sampled-particles): Any mesh becomes a particle shell of even density, assembling bottom-up, with orbit rings measured off the sampled silhouette.
- [Text-Target Particle Glyphs](https://kinetic.example.com/c/text-target-particle-glyphs): A particle cloud gathers into a word rasterised from a font already on the page, written left to right, then lets it go.
- [Cover-Fit UV Maths](https://kinetic.example.com/c/uv-cover-fit): object-fit: cover for a textured quad, solved in UV space so the crop follows a frame that reshapes every frame.
- [Velocity Afterimage Pass](https://kinetic.example.com/c/velocity-afterimage-pass): Marks that smear into a tail when the pointer moves fast and stay crisp when it slows, from two targets swapping roles.
- [Vertex Shader Cylinder Bend](https://kinetic.example.com/c/vertex-cylinder-bend): A flat plane wrapped around a cylinder on the GPU, with the curvature living in a uniform you can animate.

## Cursor

- [Blend-Difference Cursor](https://kinetic.example.com/c/blend-difference-cursor): A white dot in difference blend mode inverts whatever it crosses, growing 16 to 44 to 150px on hover.
- [Cursor Clip-Path Mask](https://kinetic.example.com/c/cursor-clip-path-mask): A disc of a second layer follows the pointer; hovering the trigger grows it until it covers the panel.
- [Cursor Repulsion Burst](https://kinetic.example.com/c/cursor-repulsion-burst): An orbiting particle field the pointer pushes out of the way, and a press detonates into a shock wave with a heat band.
- [Dither Trail Image Reveal](https://kinetic.example.com/c/dither-trail-image-reveal): A dimmed image restored through a trail of Bayer-thresholded blocks that smear in the direction the pointer moved.
- [GSAP Cursor Follower](https://kinetic.example.com/c/gsap-cursor-follower): A puck that replaces the arrow inside a panel, trailing 0.4s behind and swelling to a label over targets.
- [Hover List Image Trail](https://kinetic.example.com/c/hover-list-image-trail): Hovering a row stacks a plate into a column that follows the pointer; the oldest is culled past twenty.
- [Magnetic Pointer Button](https://kinetic.example.com/c/magnetic-button): A button that leans toward the cursor and springs back, with the label leading the box.
- [Pointer Palette Sampling](https://kinetic.example.com/c/pointer-palette-sampling): Point at the artwork and it names the colour — a clamped pixel read snapped to the nearest palette entry.
- [Pointer-Variable Gradient](https://kinetic.example.com/c/pointer-var-gradient): A soft glow tracks the pointer through two CSS custom properties. No rAF, no tween, no string rebuilding.
- [Pooled Cursor Image Trail](https://kinetic.example.com/c/pooled-image-trail): Tiles drop behind the cursor from a fixed ring of 22 reused nodes, one every 130px of travel.
- [quickTo Cursor Preview](https://kinetic.example.com/c/quickto-cursor-preview): A preview panel drifts a full second behind the pointer, driven by two reused quickTo tweens.
- [Radial Mask Spotlight](https://kinetic.example.com/c/radial-mask-spotlight): A layer masked to a soft disc follows the pointer, with a flat core that makes it read as a beam.
- [Tweened Cursor Uniform](https://kinetic.example.com/c/tweened-cursor-uniform): A shader grid with a lens under the pointer, whose position is tweened into the uniform so it settles instead of chasing.

## Transition

- [A/B Layer Ping-Pong](https://kinetic.example.com/c/ab-layer-crossfade): Two stacked layers alternate so any change crossfades, however fast you move between rows.
- [Asymmetric In/Out Staggers](https://kinetic.example.com/c/asymmetric-stagger): A list that arrives item by item after a hold and leaves twice as fast, from the last row backwards.
- [Canvas Handoff Transition](https://kinetic.example.com/c/canvas-handoff-transition): The live WebGL canvas is handed to the next page and flies to its new slot, instead of being destroyed and rebuilt.
- [CSS Variable Clip-Path Tween](https://kinetic.example.com/c/clip-path-variable-tween): One tweened custom property drives every clip-path on the panel, and reversing the timeline is the exit.
- [Delayed-Unmount Loader](https://kinetic.example.com/c/delayed-unmount-loader): A loading overlay that stays mounted 600ms past the signal so its fade can actually play before it leaves.
- [Exit Warp Before Navigate](https://kinetic.example.com/c/exit-warp-navigation): A ring of cards tears itself apart and rushes past the camera, and only then does the route change.
- [Hinged Container Intro](https://kinetic.example.com/c/hinged-container-intro): The page body swings up from below the fold, hinged on its own bottom edge, with captions following it in.
- [Prefetch-On-Hover Wipe](https://kinetic.example.com/c/hover-prefetch-wipe): Warms the next page on hover, wipes the screen on click, and navigates once the wipe has actually covered.
- [Idle-Gated Page States](https://kinetic.example.com/c/idle-gated-page-states): A page entrance that will not start until a floor delay has elapsed and the main thread has reported itself idle.
- [Key-Replayed Page Reveal](https://kinetic.example.com/c/page-reveal-overlay): An opaque overlay that fades away on every route change, replayed by nothing more than a changed React key.
- [Staggered Panel Wipe](https://kinetic.example.com/c/panel-wipe-preloader): An eased 0-100 counter, a word list and a five-column wipe, all on one timeline so they cannot drift.
- [Re-Key Caption Replay](https://kinetic.example.com/c/rekey-caption-replay): A caption block whose staggered entrance replays on every index change, restarted by a changed React key.
- [Preloader That Cannot Hang](https://kinetic.example.com/c/safe-preloader): An intro overlay with a hard ceiling, a minimum visible time and a once-per-session flag, so a stalled load cannot trap the page.
- [Slab Page Transition](https://kinetic.example.com/c/slab-page-transition): An opaque slab rises through the frame, the route changes under it, and it keeps going — nothing ever reverses.

## Text

- [Asymmetric Typewriter](https://kinetic.example.com/c/asymmetric-typewriter): Rotating phrases that delete at twice the speed they type, with a beat of nothing at the empty string.
- [Char Stagger Then Scale-Up](https://kinetic.example.com/c/char-stagger-scale-up): Characters resolve left to right, then the whole word scales up with an overshoot as the last one lands.
- [Converging Headline Words](https://kinetic.example.com/c/converging-scrub-words): Headline words slide in from opposite margins and lock into a sentence, pinned to scroll position.
- [Eased Number Counter](https://kinetic.example.com/c/eased-number-counter): A statistic that counts up on an eased curve and settles on its exact final figure without shifting the layout.
- [Font-Safe Text Splitting](https://kinetic.example.com/c/font-safe-text-split): Line splitting gated on document.fonts.ready, re-split on late fonts and on width change, debounced.
- [Letter Scramble](https://kinetic.example.com/c/morphsvg-letter-scramble): A word assembles out of noise — each character flips through wrong glyphs, decelerating onto the right one.
- [Nested Split With True Restore](https://kinetic.example.com/c/nested-splittext-restore): Splits rich markup into masked lines and restores the original innerHTML byte-for-byte on teardown.
- [Scrubbed Character Colour Reveal](https://kinetic.example.com/c/scrub-char-color-reveal): A dim paragraph resolves character by character as it crosses the viewport, tied to scroll position not a clock.
- [Pixels-Per-Second Marquee](https://kinetic.example.com/c/seamless-marquee): A marquee whose duration is derived from measured width and a px/second speed, so every strip moves at the same rate.
- [Step-End Blinking Caret](https://kinetic.example.com/c/step-end-caret): A text caret that snaps on and off instead of fading, using step-end timing and an uneven blink rhythm.
- [Stroke-To-Fill Hover Rows](https://kinetic.example.com/c/stroke-to-fill-hover): An index of outlined type where the hovered row fills in solid, drops its stroke, and steps sideways.

## Layout

- [Auto-Advance Filmstrip](https://kinetic.example.com/c/auto-advance-filmstrip): A centred strip that steps one panel every few seconds, neighbours dimmed and shrunk, on one CSS transition.
- [Drag Marquee](https://kinetic.example.com/c/drag-marquee): An endless row that drifts, takes a drag and a throw, and scatters its cards while your hand is down.
- [FOV-Derived Row Spacing](https://kinetic.example.com/c/fov-derived-row-step): A row whose item spacing is solved from a field of view and a camera distance, so it spans the frame exactly at any size.
- [Height-First Media Stage](https://kinetic.example.com/c/height-first-media-stage): A media stage sized from its height, with the width derived from the ratio, cross-fading layers and a caption that replays per index.
- [Layout Lerp Scalar](https://kinetic.example.com/c/layout-lerp-scalar): Row, stack, drum and fan are one placement function of seven numbers. Switching layout is a tween over an object.
- [matchMedia Layout Teardown](https://kinetic.example.com/c/matchmedia-layout-teardown): Two layouts behind one gsap.matchMedia block. Cross the breakpoint and the desktop branch reverts itself.
- [Percent Slide Carousel](https://kinetic.example.com/c/percent-slide-carousel): A flex track translated by -100% per slide. One CSS transition, no measurement, no library.
- [Perspective Coverflow Scroller](https://kinetic.example.com/c/perspective-coverflow-scroller): Panels turn away from the centre in real 3D as you scroll a native container — no tween, no loop.
- [Proximity Snap Track](https://kinetic.example.com/c/proximity-snap-track): A horizontal rail of variable-width cards that snaps only when you stop near one, and never skips past two at once.
- [Rotary Drag Carousel](https://kinetic.example.com/c/rotary-drag-carousel): A wheel of cards you grab and spin. Angular drag, projected inertia, and it always lands on a station.
- [Wrapping Drum Carousel](https://kinetic.example.com/c/wrapping-drum-carousel): An endless carousel that reads as a rotating drum with no 3D at all — only x, scale and fading opacity.

## Primitives

- [Analytic Disc Picking](https://kinetic.example.com/c/analytic-disc-picking): Hit-test camera-facing discs by intersecting the pointer ray with their plane. Exact, allocation-free, and correct for shader billboards.
- [Browser Chrome Frame](https://kinetic.example.com/c/browser-chrome-frame): A macOS window frame with hover-revealed traffic lights and an address pill whose check draws itself on copy.
- [Chord-Synced Particle Burst](https://kinetic.example.com/c/burst-audio-sync): Fires an arpeggio and its visual flares off one schedule, so each flash lands on its own note.
- [Capture-Phase Click Swallow](https://kinetic.example.com/c/capture-phase-click-swallow): Cancels the single click a finished drag would fire, in the capture phase, without eating the next real click or keyboard activation.
- [Compound Group Hover Card](https://kinetic.example.com/c/compound-group-hover): One hover drives four changes on three elements, each with its own duration and curve. Keyboard gets all four.
- [Conic @property Border](https://kinetic.example.com/c/conic-property-border): A gradient ring that rotates around a rounded box. Two highlights chase each other; no JavaScript runs.
- [Raycaster-Free Hover Picking](https://kinetic.example.com/c/cpu-mirror-picking): Run the GPU's transform again on the CPU and hit-test the result. No raycaster, no rect reads.
- [Dotted Notepad Surface](https://kinetic.example.com/c/dotted-notepad-surface): A tiled dot grid that dissolves at the panel edges, with a hard-stopped folded corner.
- [Drag with a Dead Zone and Pointer Capture](https://kinetic.example.com/c/drag-deadzone-capture): Captures the pointer on press but only commits to a drag past a distance threshold, so a shaky click stays a click.
- [Drifting Smoke Layers](https://kinetic.example.com/c/drifting-smoke-layers): Slow volumetric fog built from blurred radial gradients on three coprime cycles. No texture, no canvas.
- [Looping Scroll Cue](https://kinetic.example.com/c/looping-scroll-cue): The hairline that dives down a hero. One keyframe pair, a hard ease, and a seamless loop.
- [Lottie Ratio Poster](https://kinetic.example.com/c/lottie-ratio-poster): Reserves the box, holds a drawn poster, fetches the JSON only in view, then corrects the ratio from the animation's own w and h.
- [Nav Dot Wave](https://kinetic.example.com/c/nav-dot-wave): Nav dots that lift in sequence. The index is an inline custom property; CSS derives the delay.
- [Pause, Don't Unmount](https://kinetic.example.com/c/pause-dont-unmount): React 19's Activity hides a WebGL scene without losing its state. Effects still tear down, so the GL context is genuinely released.
- [Relaxed Seeded Scatter](https://kinetic.example.com/c/relaxed-seeded-scatter): Seeded angles around a ring, pushed apart until nothing collides. Ghost ticks mark where they started.
- [Self-Parking RAF](https://kinetic.example.com/c/self-parking-raf): An epsilon snap lets a damped value reach its target exactly, so the frame loop hits its exit test and dies.
- [Slow Idle Float](https://kinetic.example.com/c/slow-float-idle): A 14px rise and fall over 5 seconds, on the independent translate property so hover transforms still work.
- [Spring To CSS linear()](https://kinetic.example.com/c/spring-to-linear-easing): Solves a spring once, samples it into a CSS linear() string, and runs the whole bounce on the compositor.
- [Web Audio Scheduling Kit](https://kinetic.example.com/c/web-audio-scheduler): A lookahead sequencer: a coarse timer queues beats onto the sample-accurate audio clock, so tempo never drifts.
- [Wheel Accumulator Stepper](https://kinetic.example.com/c/wheel-accumulator-stepper): Wheel input normalised by deltaMode and accumulated to a threshold, so one flick of any device moves exactly one step.
- [Shortest Signed Ring Offset](https://kinetic.example.com/c/wrapped-ring-offset): Ten dots on a ring, each showing its wrapped offset and the raw index difference it replaces.

## Actions

- [Button](https://kinetic.example.com/c/button): Primary, secondary, ghost and danger buttons in three sizes, with gradient fills that fade on hover and a soft press.
- [Button Group](https://kinetic.example.com/c/button-group): Secondary buttons fused into one bordered strip with hairline dividers, for toolbars, range pickers and pressed toggles.
- [Close Button](https://kinetic.example.com/c/close-button): Circular dismiss button in four sizes whose X is redrawn per size, so the stroke is a true 1.6 to 2.5px at every scale.
- [Copy Page Button](https://kinetic.example.com/c/copy-page-button): Docs split button: the main half copies the page as Markdown and flips to Copied, the chevron opens Copy and View as Markdown.
- [GitHub Star Button](https://kinetic.example.com/c/github-star-button): A star toggle with a glyph, a Star label and a count pill. Starring pops the star and rolls the en-US formatted count by one.
- [Icon Button](https://kinetic.example.com/c/icon-button): Square bordered icon-only button in 36 and 32px with a fixed 10px radius, plus an anchor twin for navigational actions.
- [Link Button](https://kinetic.example.com/c/link-button): Container-less text action that renders an anchor with href or a button without, with an underline as its only hover cue.
- [Notification Bell Badge](https://kinetic.example.com/c/notification-bell-badge): Bell button with a red unread badge that opens a notification popover; mark one or all read and the badge follows.
- [Quick Search Button](https://kinetic.example.com/c/quick-search-button): A "Search..." field-style trigger with a ⌘K hint that opens the kit command palette, and a global ⌘K / Ctrl+K shortcut that toggles it.
- [Social Button](https://kinetic.example.com/c/social-button): Sign-in button for 24 named providers: one brand prop supplies logo, colour and label, in colourful, black or outlined styles.
- [Theme Toggle](https://kinetic.example.com/c/theme-toggle): Light and dark switch that reveals the new theme in a soft circle growing from the click point, using the View Transition API.

## Forms

- [Accent Swatch Picker](https://kinetic.example.com/c/accent-swatch-picker): Glossy colour spheres in one keyboard radio group; the pick becomes one --accent property that re-tints kit controls in its scope.
- [Agent Creator](https://kinetic.example.com/c/agent-creator): A create-an-agent card: paper avatar with a face ring and shape arc, colour pill, profile, tools and voice fields, then a created summary.
- [Checkbox](https://kinetic.example.com/c/checkbox): React Aria checkbox in two sizes: a gradient box whose white tick draws itself on, plus an indeterminate dash for partial selections.
- [Checkbox Card](https://kinetic.example.com/c/checkbox-card): Bordered option card with title and description on the left and the kit checkbox on the right; a click anywhere on it toggles.
- [Color Picker](https://kinetic.example.com/c/color-picker): A saturation field, hue and opacity rails, a hex field and presets, inline or behind a round swatch that opens a popover.
- [Combobox](https://kinetic.example.com/c/combobox): Type to filter a list: Input's own field with a chevron toggle, and a field-width menu with sections, a check and a scroll fade.
- [Composer Attachments](https://kinetic.example.com/c/composer-attachments): 56px attachment tiles for a chat composer: type icon, name, size and remove, with a ring that traces the tile edge while uploading.
- [Composer Footer](https://kinetic.example.com/c/composer-footer): Bottom bar of a chat composer: attach, tool toggles, a model slot and a key hint, with a send button that becomes stop while replying.
- [Composer Panel](https://kinetic.example.com/c/composer-panel): Two-row agent composer: a growing prompt over a toolbar with add, permission mode, model and send, plus a status tab with a context ring.
- [Date Calendar](https://kinetic.example.com/c/date-calendar): An inline month calendar for one date or a range, with a continuous range band, a today dot and struck-through unavailable days.
- [Date Picker](https://kinetic.example.com/c/date-picker): A trigger button that opens one month in a popover, with an editable DD/MM/YYYY chip and Cancel / Apply so nothing commits early.
- [Date Range Picker](https://kinetic.example.com/c/date-range-picker): Two adjacent months in a popover with a quick-select sidebar, typed start and end chips, a day count and Cancel / Apply.
- [Date Range Stepper](https://kinetic.example.com/c/date-range-stepper): A bordered pill with prev/next chevrons that steps a week or month period, with min/max bounds and a label that slides in.
- [File Upload](https://kinetic.example.com/c/file-upload): A drag-and-drop zone that validates type and size, traces progress around its own border, then reports the finished file.
- [Image Prompt Composer](https://kinetic.example.com/c/image-prompt-composer): The request form of an image model: style chips, an auto-growing prompt, ratio select, count stepper and a Generate that turns into Stop.
- [Input](https://kinetic.example.com/c/input): React Aria text field on a filled shell with an inset ring for hover and focus, label with required mark, hint or error line, and icons.
- [Input OTP](https://kinetic.example.com/c/input-otp): One-time-code field: a monospace box per digit that advances on type, steps back on Backspace, spreads a paste and accepts OS autofill.
- [Language Select](https://kinetic.example.com/c/language-select): A footer language picker on the kit Select: translate glyph or flag in the trigger, flag emoji, native names with lang and dir per option.
- [Meeting Scheduler](https://kinetic.example.com/c/meeting-scheduler): A Cal.com-style booking popover: host and meeting summary, a month calendar and a half-hour slot list, committed by "Send meeting".
- [Model Select](https://kinetic.example.com/c/model-select): Model picker on the kit Select. Rows show a tinted monogram, name, description, New/Pro badges and a check on the current model.
- [Models Picker](https://kinetic.example.com/c/models-picker): A card of models with provider monograms: pick one with radios, or enable several with switches, a search filter and a live count.
- [Newsletter Card](https://kinetic.example.com/c/newsletter-card): Email sign-up card with inline validation, a submitting state on a cleaned-up timer, success with reset, and an error path.
- [Number Field](https://kinetic.example.com/c/number-field): Input's field shell plus minus and plus steppers on React Aria NumberField: locale currency, percent and unit formats, clamped to limits.
- [Questionnaire](https://kinetic.example.com/c/questionnaire): The questions an agent asks before it plans: one per step, checkbox or numbered rows, a free-text Other and step pills.
- [Radio](https://kinetic.example.com/c/radio): React Aria radio group with a gradient selected dot that cross-fades in while the white centre scales up, in two sizes.
- [Radio Card](https://kinetic.example.com/c/radio-card): Bordered option card with title, description and the kit radio dot on the right; inside a RadioGroup a click anywhere selects it.
- [Search Field](https://kinetic.example.com/c/search-field): Pill or rounded search input on React Aria SearchField: Escape clears, a clear button scales in with text, and the icon fades to a spinner.
- [Segmented Control](https://kinetic.example.com/c/segmented-control): A pill switcher for Weekly / Monthly / Yearly choices: one white thumb, measured from the DOM, slides under the selected segment.
- [Select](https://kinetic.example.com/c/select): A React Aria select: bordered trigger with a turning chevron, non-modal popover on the shared menu surface, free-form rows.
- [Slider](https://kinetic.example.com/c/slider): Single and min/max sliders on React Aria: a gradient fill, thumbs that grow while dragged, and a value bubble above each thumb.
- [Status Select Cell](https://kinetic.example.com/c/status-select-cell): Table status pill in status-* colours that is also a select: hover reveals a chevron, press or Enter opens the list to change it.
- [Switch](https://kinetic.example.com/c/switch): React Aria toggle with a gradient track, a white thumb that slides 200ms, and an embossed chip that turns blue when on; 3 sizes, 2 shapes.
- [Switch Card](https://kinetic.example.com/c/switch-card): Bordered settings row with an optional icon, title and description; a click anywhere on the card flips the kit switch on its trailing edge.
- [Table Filter Bar](https://kinetic.example.com/c/table-filter-bar): Strip above a data table: "All ..." select filters, a pill search, removable active-filter chips, Clear all and a live result count.
- [Textarea](https://kinetic.example.com/c/textarea): Multiline sibling of Input on the same filled shell: grows a line at a time up to maxRows, or keeps a resize handle; optional counter.
- [Time Field](https://kinetic.example.com/c/time-field): A time of day typed segment by segment in the kit's input shell, with 12 or 24 hour cycles, seconds, limits and an accent focus.
- [Users Access Card](https://kinetic.example.com/c/users-access-card): Workspace members with initials, email and a role select per row, a remove button, and an invite field that validates before adding a row.

## Overlays

- [Command Palette](https://kinetic.example.com/c/command-palette): ⌘K palette of searchable commands with sections, icons and shortcuts, built-in or custom filtering, on React Aria Autocomplete and Menu.
- [Context Menu](https://kinetic.example.com/c/context-menu): Right-click, long-press and Shift+F10 menu anchored to the pointer, with icons, shortcuts, submenus and checkable rows.
- [Drawer](https://kinetic.example.com/c/drawer): Panel that slides in from any edge over a dimmed page, for filters, details and bottom sheets, sharing Modal's header, body and actions.
- [Dropdown](https://kinetic.example.com/c/dropdown): Composable popover menu (trigger, panel, groups, rows, dividers) built on React Aria: the recipe behind the sidebar team and account menus.
- [Event Detail Popover](https://kinetic.example.com/c/event-detail-popover): Anchored calendar event card: colour key, date and time, location, meeting code with Join, guest RSVPs, edit and delete.
- [Modal](https://kinetic.example.com/c/modal): Dialog over a dimmed page with a header, scrolling body and actions, plus an alert dialog for destructive confirms.
- [Notification](https://kinetic.example.com/c/notification): Dismissible notification card with status icon or avatar, actions and a pausable countdown bar, stacked in a corner viewport.
- [Popover](https://kinetic.example.com/c/popover): Free-form content anchored to a trigger, with an optional arrow, smart positioning and the menu family's motion, built on React Aria.
- [Pro Upsell Toast](https://kinetic.example.com/c/pro-upsell-toast): A floating Upgrade-to-Pro card with a grainy pastel wash, app tile, dismiss and a full-width CTA; it rises in and returns focus on close.
- [Row Actions](https://kinetic.example.com/c/row-actions): Kebab menu at the end of a table row with Edit, Duplicate and a red Delete that asks first through the kit AlertDialog.
- [Toast](https://kinetic.example.com/c/toast): Imperative toast() with success, error, update and dismiss, drawn by one Toaster as a capped, pausable stack of Notification cards.
- [Tooltip](https://kinetic.example.com/c/tooltip): Light-surface tooltip built on React Aria, with a hand-drawn caret per side and a quick blur-and-scale in and out.

- [Month Stepper](https://kinetic.example.com/c/month-stepper): A bordered month label between prev/next chevrons, with spinbutton keys: arrows step a month, Page Up/Down a year, Home/End the bounds.
- [On This Page TOC](https://kinetic.example.com/c/on-this-page-toc): Right-hand "On this page" list that tracks the section you are reading with an IntersectionObserver and a sliding active bar.
- [Pagination](https://kinetic.example.com/c/pagination): Controlled pager with Previous/Next buttons, 32px page cells and ellipsis collapsing that turns compact below a 420px container.
- [Repo Tree Nav](https://kinetic.example.com/c/repo-tree-nav): Repository file tree with folder expand/collapse, file-type icons, single file selection and +/− line counts per file.
- [Tabs](https://kinetic.example.com/c/tabs): React Aria underline tabs with a measured 2px indicator that slides between tabs, plus a pill switcher whose thumb settles with a spring.
- [Tree View](https://kinetic.example.com/c/tree-view): React Aria file tree with curved guide lines, folder icons that open, and rows that unfold and blur in as branches expand.
- [Workspace Switcher](https://kinetic.example.com/c/workspace-switcher): Sidebar-top workspace menu: mark, name and plan on the trigger, a checked list of workspaces and a create-workspace row.

- [Finance Dashboard](https://kinetic.example.com/c/finance-dashboard): A full finance dashboard page: in-block sidebar views, KPI cards, cash flow, spending, portfolio, daily spend and a live transactions table.
- [GitHub Stars CTA](https://kinetic.example.com/c/github-stars-cta): Open-source free tier section: copy and checklist beside a repo card with a counting star total, star button and repo facts.
- [Home Dashboard](https://kinetic.example.com/c/home-dashboard): A full home dashboard page: in-block sidebar views, hires, earnings, revenue, contributions, key numbers and a working customers table.
- [Marketing Dashboard](https://kinetic.example.com/c/marketing-dashboard): A full marketing dashboard page: in-block sidebar views, key metrics, funnel, channel spend, traffic, ad spend, visitors and campaigns.
- [Medical Profile](https://kinetic.example.com/c/medical-profile): A full patient dashboard page: profile, steps, sleep, a day picker driving activity rings, alerts and a filterable patients table.
- [Multi Agent Chat](https://kinetic.example.com/c/multi-agent-chat): A group chat with a team of agents who reply in turn, plus a workspace switcher and a panel to edit agents and browse files.
- [Not Found Page](https://kinetic.example.com/c/not-found-page): A 404 block: big error code, the missing path, home and browse actions, suggested page cards and an agent footnote, staggered in.
- [Notification Center](https://kinetic.example.com/c/notification-center): Tabbed activity inbox with unread counts, avatars or status icons, inline action buttons and a mark-all-read control.
- [Plan Comparison Table](https://kinetic.example.com/c/plan-comparison-table): Feature-by-plan table with a sticky plan header, collapsible groups, check, dash and text cells, and a tinted highlighted column.
- [Pricing Plan Cards](https://kinetic.example.com/c/pricing-plan-cards): Plan cards with a monthly/yearly switch that rolls the prices, shows yearly savings, highlights one plan and lists features with icons.
- [Project Board](https://kinetic.example.com/c/project-board): A full kanban page: drag tickets across five columns, open a side panel to edit them, create, sort and filter, with an activity inbox.
- [Rotating Word Hero](https://kinetic.example.com/c/rotating-word-hero): Landing hero whose key word slides and blurs through a list while the line glides to each new width, with CTAs and a stack badges row.
- [Settings Modal](https://kinetic.example.com/c/settings-modal): A controlled settings dialog with a section rail and General, Profile, Tools and Storage pages. It scales in from 85% with a light blur.
- [Sidebar](https://kinetic.example.com/c/sidebar): A floating dashboard sidebar that folds from 260px to a 60px icon rail, with ⌘L nav search, team and account menus and a settings entry.
- [Site Footer](https://kinetic.example.com/c/site-footer): Marketing footer: logo, tagline and socials, six link columns with View all counts, then a language, theme, swatch and legal bar.
- [Site Header](https://kinetic.example.com/c/site-header): Marketing header with a menu link, a ⌘K search pill, a GitHub star pill and the theme toggle, folding into a drawer in narrow containers.
- [Template Showcase Tabs](https://kinetic.example.com/c/template-showcase-tabs): Landing section with a framed card of template tabs: a pill slides to the chosen tab and miniature app layouts crossfade below it.
- [Testimonial Carousel](https://kinetic.example.com/c/testimonial-carousel): A centred quote carousel with faded neighbours, initials avatars, prev / next, progress dots and autoplay that pauses on hover and focus.
